method: Only completed metrics states permit final-document reads. Planned missing/starting runs remain explicit pending; no best-of selection.

The model's native final reference is matched to the exact same-run check input/output and original verdict.yaml/data; draft/document SHA256 are verified independently. Prior check drafts and mechanical_clear do not receive semantic credit.
Positive facts and boundaries use the same frozen oracle and 0/.5/1 scale as raw. Core binary pass is not preregistered; no temporary pass threshold is added.
Raw evidence locations are resolved to original pool files by unique transcript filename tag and physical line. Synthetic seq/version coordinates are not treated as raw semantic truth.
Extra false claims, annotation corrections and source-level limitations are separate from recovery points; no YAML-format benefit or penalty.
H3-P1 has partial_pre_freeze_exposure and is appendix-only. No source, frozen run or raw scoring artifact is modified.
